ran_by: the session that ran this experiment, on 2026-10-21, in one cloud container
how: sunspot setup transfer.ccs: gnark's groth16.Setup, one party, randomness from the container, no ceremony
toxic_waste: not provably destroyed; it lived in one process's memory, which has exited. Whoever ran it could forge proofs for this circuit. Fit for a gas measurement, not for value
kept: all three are committed beside this file: the verifying key transfer.vk, the R1CS transfer.ccs (4.3 MB) and the proving key transfer.pk (13.9 MB), so that a new proof the deployed verifier accepts can be made from groth16tool prove. The proving key is public by design; what must not exist is the setup's toxic waste, and that is the caveat above
